scope: Cancel cold inference admission and reject generated report names hidden by horizontal title spacing

admission.change: Model verification checks cancellation between 64 KiB reads, while waiting for an identical verification, and before publishing or reusing a receipt. Cold translation environment admission uses the same cancellable model path. Worker admission and startup check cancellation before progressing.
admission.error_semantics: Typed cancellation is neither model corruption nor a GPU failure eligible for CPU retry. Existing successful receipts are not revoked by a cancelled cache lookup.
admission.trace: Bounded stage/status/duration metadata for model verification, backend selection, runtime verification and worker checkout. Preparation costs stay separate from chat tokens and request time; cancelled, failed or incomplete observations never qualify as a successful benchmark.
limitations: Cannot interrupt an operating-system read already in progress.
Runtime executable hashing is checked before and after, not between reads.
Cold environment refresh preceding translation admission is not included in the four worker-admission stage durations.
The previous real Metal cancellation trial had no worker/request observation and remains indeterminate. These changes do not retroactively make it pass.
No measured whole-meeting CPU, memory, energy or GPU speed improvement is claimed.

generated_report_validation.reproduction: An ordinary all-Chinese article with PAN MALE FERGUSON followed by a horizontal space and 教授 passed final validation although the current source spelling was 潘 MALE FERGUSON. The original failing result is retained.
generated_report_validation.stopped_experiment: Cross-line name recovery was withheld: preceding line scope could not be established from current sources, and broadening recovery exposed the existing title-gap validation hole. No keyword-denylist workaround or model retry was used to force a pass.
generated_report_validation.quality_gate: Q16 remains open; detecting unsupported content is not a demonstration that the model generates a complete faithful article.
generated_report_validation.change: Only generated-body validation uses a temporary horizontal title-gap view. Original source name inventory, institution/report authority, stored text and recovery APIs remain strict and unchanged.
generated_report_validation.source_gap_control: Independent review reproduced an intermediate mistake: normalizing a source-only ALICE SMITH title gap admitted a different university. Removed source normalization. Sources without strict literal name evidence conservatively reject rather than grant new authority; both original red results remain archived.

delivery.coordination: Shared source goes to PR #1 after checks. Windows/Linux device validation and PR #14 hybrid-GPU selection remain with their existing owners. CUDA/Vulkan remain optional downloads; Apple Silicon retains Metal.
